content_sections.heading: Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognized institution or university , have two years of qualifying work experience and meet the prescribed typing and computer requirements. Candidates need to satisfy either the English or Hindi typing speed requirement, not both. The required two-year experience must be as a Junior Assistant or in an equivalent position in one of the following organizations: Universities or research establishments. Central or State Government organizations. Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). Autonomous bodies. Reputed private companies or corporate banks offering an equivalent pay package, with minimum annual turnover of Rs. 200 crore. The prescribed qualification and experience must be possessed by the applicable application closing date.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Assistant Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Age relaxation is available to eligible SC, ST, OBC, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and other categories under applicable Central Government orders adopted by Delhi University. Applicants with at least three years of regular service in the same or allied field in eligible government, university, autonomous or PSU organizations may receive relaxation up to five years or the number of completed years of qualifying service, whichever is less. The notification also provides specific age exemptions for eligible departmental candidates and certain contractual, daily-wage or ad hoc employees directly appointed by Delhi University or its affiliated/constituent colleges. Important: The special contractual-employee exemption does not apply to outsourced employees or project-based contractual assignments.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Assistant Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The Assistant post carries Pay Level 4 under the 7th Central Pay Commission , with allowances admissible under University rules.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Assistant Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a Preliminary Test, Main Examination and qualifying Skill Test . The Preliminary Test is used for shortlisting, while the Main Examination determines merit, subject to qualification in the Skill Test. Preliminary Test - Objective MCQ examination. Main Examination - Descriptive examination. Skill Test - Computer proficiency, office procedures, noting, drafting and typing. Document Verification - Verification of qualification, experience and other eligibility claims. Final Merit - Based on Main Examination marks, subject to applicable selection rules.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Assistant Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Preliminary Test consists of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 200 marks , with a duration of two hours and 30 minutes. Important: The Preliminary Test is only for shortlisting and does not carry weightage in final merit. The qualifying cut-off is determined using 50% of the average score of the top 5% of candidates appearing in the test, subject to the special calculation provisions in the notification. The notification provides a five-percentage-point relaxation for SC/ST candidates and a ten-percentage-point relaxation for PwBD candidates in the prescribed cut-off. For shortlisting to the Main Examination, the University prescribes 30 candidates for one vacancy and 15 additional candidates for each further vacancy, subject to merit and ties at the cut-off. The Main Examination is descriptive in nature and carries 200 marks, with a duration of two hours. The Main Examination assesses knowledge of higher education administration, financial rules, university procedures, procurement, pension rules, grievance handling and administrative management. The Skill Test carries 100 marks and is qualifying in nature. Candidates must obtain at least 50 marks to qualify. The Skill Test covers the Manual of Office Procedures, noting and drafting, computer operations and typing proficiency.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Assistant Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: General Studies: General Science, current affairs, Indian History, National Movement, Constitution, Polity, Economy and Geography. Reasoning: Analytical ability, decision-making, data analysis and interpretation. Mathematics: Mathematical calculations, statistical analysis and commercial mathematics of secondary and higher secondary standard. Higher Education Administration: Rules and policies of higher educational institutions, nodal agencies, financial and administrative functioning, and Delhi University Acts, Statutes and Ordinances. Educational Administration and Management. Higher Education System and Regulatory Bodies in India. Financial Administration and Budget Preparation. Information and Communication Technology in University Administration. Fundamental Rules and Supplementary Rules. General Financial Rules and Government Procurement through GeM. Pension Rules and Grievance Handling. The examination papers will be bilingual in English and Hindi. Candidates must use the same chosen language throughout the examination, subject to the instructions in the notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive for the Assistant post is conducted by Delhi University to fill 215 vacancies across its offices and departments under advertisement number R&P/325/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available for the Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 215 vacancies available for the post of Assistant in this recruitment notification released by Delhi University for eligible and qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026 is 19 November 2026. Candidates must apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s Degree from any recognized Institute/University, along with two years of relevant experience and specific typing speed requirements in English or Hindi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants applying for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 32 years as on the closing date of the advertisement. Age relaxations apply as per government rules for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or pay scale for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates selected for the Assistant post through this recruitment process will be placed under Pay Level - 04 as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General and Unreserved category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and Unreserved category applicants is Rs. 1,000/-. Reduced fee structures apply for OBC, EWS, Female, SC, ST, and PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Delhi University Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises Stage 1: Preliminary test (MCQ based) for shortlisting, followed by Stage 2: Examination (Main) (Descriptive) and a subsequent Skill Test.

faq.question: Q9. Through which mode can candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to submit their applications exclusively through online mode by visiting the official website of Delhi University at www.du.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. Who is exempted from paying the application fee?
faq.answer: Applicants who had previously applied for the post of Assistant advertised under Advt. No. R&P/311/2024 dated 12.12.2024 are fully exempted from paying the application fee.
